name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index 98 and US 10-year yield 5.10% on 12 Nov; MOVE has not cleared the exit margin, so Watch holds
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility was near 98 on 12 Nov, little changed over a month, and the US 10-year yield was near 5.10%, about 1bp higher than a month earlier and 10bp up on the week (Yahoo Finance). MOVE sits just under the 100 Watch line but has not cleared the exit margin, so Watch holds; the 10-year is 21bp below its 52-week high of 5.31%.
for_you: US borrowing costs remain high, which feeds through to mortgage and loan rates internationally; volatility in government bond markets is moderate.
rubric_hit: MOVE 98 has not cleared the exit line below 100, so Watch holds; US 10y 1m move 1bp below the 40bp line

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofAML MOVE Index (^MOVE)

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
